description: Job board: prepare (unsigned) POSTING a report job paid in $ZENI: an approve (reward plus the fee) and the post. You pass the job text as `params` (plain text fields t, d, s, brief; no links); the tool puts its hash on chain. AFTER the post is mined you MUST show the text to the Worker with the poster-only route jobs/describe (the site API, signed in as the poster) using the SAME params, or nobody can take the job. Reward bounds, the per-poster open limit and the wallet cap are read from the board.

days.description: How long the job stays open: 1 to 7 days (default 3).

params.description: Job text: { t: title (max 80), d: detail (max 600), brief: one line (max 300), s: sector (max 40) }; plain text, no links.

rewardZeni.description: Reward in whole $ZENI (the board has a minimum).

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_board_post
